en.headline: Health Department seizes about 100 boxes of unregistered painkillers
en.dek: Officers recovered suspected unregistered products carrying Japanese labels and containing ibuprofen and dihydrocodeine from a licensed pharmacy, a medicine shop and two other outlets; a 38-year-old man was arrested.
body: The Department of Health said it had seized about 100 boxes of suspected unregistered pharmaceutical products during surprise inspections in Tsim Sha Tsui, Causeway Bay, Sheung Shui and Yuen Long on 5 August.

The products, mostly labelled in Japanese and without Hong Kong registration numbers, were claimed to have pain-relieving effects and were believed to contain ibuprofen and dihydrocodeine. They were found in one licensed pharmacy, one medicine shop and two other retail premises.

A 38-year-old man was arrested by police on suspicion of illegal possession of unregistered pharmaceutical products and Part 1 poisons under the Pharmacy and Poisons Ordinance. The Department said investigations continue and further prosecutions may follow if evidence is sufficient.

Dihydrocodeine is an opioid analgesic used for cough and pain relief; side effects can include nausea, vomiting, constipation and drowsiness. Products containing ibuprofen or dihydrocodeine are classified as Part 1 poisons and may only be sold under the supervision of a registered pharmacist or on a doctor’s instruction.

zh.headline: 衞生署檢約百盒懷疑未註冊止痛藥 38歲男子被捕
zh.dek: 署方在尖沙咀、銅鑼灣、上水及元朗突擊巡查，於一間持牌藥房、一間藥行及兩間店舖檢獲約100盒大多附日文標籤的懷疑未註冊藥劑製品，一名38歲男子涉非法管有被捕。
body: 衞生署表示，今日在尖沙咀、銅鑼灣、上水及元朗等多區進行突擊巡查，於一間持牌藥房、一間藥行及兩間店舖內檢獲約100盒報稱有止痛功效的懷疑未經註冊藥劑製品。
產品大多以日文標籤，沒有附印香港藥劑製品註冊編號，懷疑含有布洛芬及二氫可待因。一名38歲男子涉嫌違反藥物相關法例，包括非法管有未經註冊藥劑製品及第1部毒藥，已被警方拘捕。
衞生署會繼續調查，並在證據充分時向其他涉案人士提出檢控。二氫可待因屬鴉片類鎮痛藥，可用作鎮咳及紓緩痛楚，副作用包括噁心、嘔吐、便秘及昏昏欲睡。
含有布洛芬及二氫可待因的藥劑製品均屬《藥劑業及毒藥條例》下的第1部毒藥，只應在註冊藥劑師監督下於藥房出售或在醫生指示下使用。
